svg.title: Two-bone swivel IK: the knee lies on a circle around the hip-to-foot axis; the swivel angle picks the point
svg.text: The knee can only be on this circle; the swivel φ picks where
Limb plane, side on: fixed by d alone
Mid(φ) = C + r·(cos φ·U + sin φ·V)
d fixes θ, α, a and r; φ is the only free angle.
A pole vector is just one way to encode φ.
